description: The Crypto module is composed of several logical modules: AES - implements the AES algorithm with key sizes of 128 and 256 bits in CBC and ECB modes; SHA - implements the secure hash algorithm SHA1; HMAC - implements HMAC algorithm with SHA1 as the hash function; API - implements FIPS required tests and provides external APIs.
